offence_note: Aggravated sexual assault; assault causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed only to the extent that the appellant's sentence on Count 1 of a further 673 days' imprisonment is reduced to a further 566 days' imprisonment (from 7 January 2014). The sentence on Count 2 is unchanged.
note: Appeal only corrected pre-sentence credit; 4y plus 1y consecutive total inferred.

offence_note: Assault with a weapon (two counts) and assault; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: The evidence all supported the trial judge's decision to designate the appellant a dangerous offender and to impose an indeterminate sentence.
note: Acquitted of sexual assault; racial slur was said to the appellant by victim, not weighed.

sentence_quote: the court indicated that the sentence imposed was manifestly inadequate. A sentence of three years should have been imposed.
note: Three years substituted but no re-incarceration; original 13 months 18 days plus 2 years probation; mandatory minimum struck.

offence_note: Sexual interference with child (sexual assault stayed)
sentence_quote: So, I sentence you, C.A.L., to three years and six months' imprisonment, consecutive to any sentence you may be serving.
note: Consecutive to existing sentence; SOIRA 20 years; s.161 for 6 years after release.

offence_note: Sexual assault with a weapon and forcible confinement
sentence_quote: In conclusion the appeal is allowed and it is ordered that the hearing of the dangerous offender application proceed before the trial judge.
note: Crown appeal of stay of DO application allowed; hearing to proceed; earlier 11 year sentence not fixed.

sentence_quote: For the murder of Leanne Larocque, I sentence you to life imprisonment. For the murder of Gordon Turner, I sentence you to life imprisonment. In each case, you are not eligible to apply for parole until you have served at least 18 years in prison.
note: Concurrent life sentences; lifetime s.109 prohibition.

offence_note: Sexual assault, death threat, weapon possession; dangerous offender application
sentence_quote: I decline to exercise that discretion with the result that Mr. B. will simply be credited with the straight time he has already spent in custody in relation to the predicate offences.
note: Long-term offender with 10 year supervision; length of determinate jail term not shown; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Sexual interference with 15-year-old cousin (sexual assault stayed)
sentence_quote: we grant leave to appeal sentence and set aside the victim surcharge imposed upon the appellant, but otherwise dismiss the appeal from sentence.
note: Victim surcharge set aside; other ancillary orders not shown.

offence_note: Theft of gold from Mint, money laundering, breach of trust
sentence_quote: The appeal as to the restitution order is dismissed. The appeal as to the fine in lieu of forfeiture is allowed, and the fine is reduced to $130,206.19.
note: Fine in lieu of forfeiture reduced; 2y6m consecutive default term kept; jail term not appealed.

offence_note: Income tax false refunds and evasion; possession of stolen property
sentence_quote: a global sentence for all offences of three and a half years' incarceration together with a fine of $142,049.93 is just and appropriate, and I so sentence him.
note: Victim surcharge waived; conditional sentence refused.
